name: SEO Expert
tagline: Keeps watch on your site's search performance and plans fixes for your sign-off.
description: Point it at a product website and it tracks how that site performs in search, watching the numbers over time instead of grading once. From what it sees, it builds a concrete, ordered improvement plan - what to change and why each change should help. Nothing is executed until you have read the plan and given the word.
author: iammutex
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
